subject.title: Home dashboard: agent-docked widgets and a Pages shelf

question: Should OpenClaw make Home a persisted per-agent dashboard now, and if so, what is the approved v1 scope for dock placement, page ownership, refresh behavior, and platform parity?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing product mode and crosses UI, persisted state, security-sensitive rendering, gateway protocol, and multi-client behavior; source-level repair automation cannot safely choose those contracts.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow per-agent v1
options.body: Approve a vertical ordered Home dock plus local per-agent Pages, static agent-updated widget payloads, and a desktop/web-first rollout with explicit SQLite and additive protocol design review.

options.title: Keep Home as navigation only
options.body: Defer dashboard composition and retain the merged Home/sidebar implementation without adding persisted widgets or Pages.

options.title: Explore an external extension first
options.body: Validate the agent-curated dashboard workflow through an existing plugin or skill seam before committing core storage and gateway APIs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow per-agent v1
recommendation.body: Approve a vertical ordered Home dock plus local per-agent Pages, static agent-updated widget payloads, and a desktop/web-first rollout with explicit SQLite and additive protocol design review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Home/sidebar foundation and wrote the product proposal, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the intended Home direction.
